## Posy MCP Server

Posy is a free, open-source (MIT) link-in-bio builder. Its hosted remote MCP server lets an assistant create or import a page, add, update, move and remove link tiles, set the theme and profile, and publish the page. Sign-in is OAuth 2.1 with PKCE and dynamic client registration, so there is no API key to paste. All 11 tools carry read-only or destructive annotations. Posy can also be self-hosted with Docker, exposing the same server at https://YOUR-HOST/api/mcp.
